packageRules.description: Only open PRs for minor and patch updates (no major)
Ignore wagon-ssh-external (being removed) - no updates at all

camel.version is a shared Maven property driving BOTH org.apache.camel.karaf:apache-camel (the Karaf features descriptor, which lags) and base org.apache.camel:* artifacts. Disable base-camel updates so the shared property tracks ONLY camel-karaf (https://github.com/apache/camel-karaf) and never exceeds the version the Karaf features actually publish (base camel-core is already ahead, e.g. 4.21 while camel-karaf tops out at 4.18.2). When camel-karaf releases a new version, Renovate bumps the property automatically.

Base images (LSIO alpine + Temurin JRE): pinned by digest in the Dockerfile. Re-enable digest/pin for them (the global rule above turns those off for Maven) and ship both in ONE automerged PR; build.yaml on the renovate branch is the gate. The nightly auto-release in release.yaml then cuts a patch release.
Temurin tags look like 21.0.13_9-jre-alpine-3.24 (or a respin 21.0.12.1_1-…): parse the build after '_' and keep the -jre-alpine-3.24 suffix fixed, so Renovate never switches the alpine release
LSIO alpine: only follow the digest of the 3.24 tag. A move to 3.25 has to happen together with the temurin -alpine-3.25 variant, by hand
